verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone and communications SaaS with desktop and mobile apps, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking controls. The pack covers only the API, the MCP server, pricing and phone features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
